initial_test_run: First full run: 9 passed, 1 failed because freeze.json did not exist yet (expected; it is written after the tests pass). A synthetic fixture coverage gap was corrected in the test data before that run. Amendment-01: the new day-84 boundary and source-lock tests first failed against the superseded 84-day definition (single_prior became multiple), then all 11 passed under the amended definition. Amendment-02: the new unavailable-issuer clock test failed on the previous code (a wrong saved session passed), then all 12 passed. Amendment-03: before amendment-03.json existed, 15 of 17 failed at fixture setup (expected); one new assertion had a test-side type error, which was corrected; then all 17 passed. The amendment-03 tests target APIs that did not exist in the previous code, so they were not run against it. Amendment-04: the import-isolation and conflict-evidence tests failed on the previous code; after the change and re-freeze all 20 passed. Amendment-05: after the preflight change only the frozen-identity test failed until the re-freeze; then all 22 passed. The changed preflight return shape means the new preflight tests were not run against the previous code. Amendment-06: after the change only the frozen-identity test failed until the re-freeze; then all 25 passed. The new window, lazy-loading and atomic-write tests use APIs absent from the previous code; the uncapped classify call in the window test shows the earlier fixed-83-day behaviour admitting the later release. Amendment-07: the lock-ordering and invalid-lock tests failed on the previous code and pass now; all 27 passed after the re-freeze. Amendment-08: the manifest-recheck, locked-tzdata and non-file-lock tests failed on the previous code and pass now; all 30 passed after the re-freeze. Amendment-09: the history-page recheck and guarded-preflight tests failed on the previous code and pass now; all 33 passed after the re-freeze. Amendment-10: the four new 10-K-boundary, failed-attempt-identity, post-write-recheck and declaration-drift tests failed on the previous code; one older window assertion was updated for the new mapping that includes the last period (None); all 37 passed after the re-freeze. Amendment-11: the shared-lock, run-once (updated append-only test), reconciliation, event-projection and malformed-drift tests failed on the previous code; one test was reordered because a completed attempt now correctly blocks preflight; all 41 passed after the re-freeze.
